lh-audit--pass" id="is-on-https"><details class="lh-expandable-details"><summary><div class="lh-audit__header lh-expandable-details__summary"><span class="lh-audit__score-icon"></span><span class="lh-audit__title-and-text"><span class="lh-audit__title"><span>Uses HTTPS</span></span><span class="lh-audit__display-text"></span></span><div class="lh-chevron-container"><svg class="lh-chevron" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><g class="lh-chevron__lines"><path class="lh-chevron__line lh-chevron__line-left" d="M10 50h40"></path><path class="lh-chevron__line lh-chevron__line-right"
